say: You probably didn't know this about money.
Most money today is not actually cash.
It's not sitting somewhere as paper bills or coins.
If your balance says two thousand dollars, that doesn't mean the bank has a box with two thousand dollars in cash with your name on it.
show: If your balance says 2,000$, that doesn't mean the bank has a box with 2,000$ in cash with your name on it.

say: It simply means their system records that you have two thousand dollars available.

say: When someone sends you money, cash usually doesn't physically move anywhere.
The same thing happens when you use your card, pay online, or receive your salary.
So most of the money we use every day is really just numbers stored in banking systems.
Physical cash is only a small part of it.
Money today is mostly digital information.
You didn't know that about money.
